ios.desc:
BlueShifts Police Calendar is a scheduling and organizational tool built specifically for law enforcement professionals.

Built by a police officer for police officers, BlueShifts helps you keep track of shifts, off-duty details, overtime assignments, hours worked, earnings, mileage and important job information—all in one place.

Whether you're managing a busy patrol schedule, coordinating off-duty work, tracking overtime opportunities, or simply trying to stay organized, BlueShifts was designed with the unique needs of law enforcement in mind.

FEATURES

* Manage duty shifts and work schedules
* Track off-duty details and overtime assignments
* Organize leave, holidays and days off
* View schedules in an easy-to-use calendar format
* Share schedules with family members and trusted contacts

TRACK HOURS, EARNINGS AND MILEAGE

* Track hours worked across multiple assignments
* Monitor paid and pending earnings
* Calculate hourly earnings and work statistics
* Record business mileage for tax and reimbursement purposes
* Keep all your work-related information organized

KEEP IMPORTANT INFORMATION NEARBY

* Court addresses and contact information
* Jail addresses and contact information
* Hospital addresses and important reference information
* Gate codes and access information
* Tow company information
* Other useful job-related contacts and resources

DESIGNED FOR POLICE LIFE

Law enforcement professionals often juggle regular shifts, overtime opportunities, off-duty details, court appearances, training events and personal commitments. BlueShifts was created to bring everything together into a single, easy-to-use organizer built around the realities of police work.

PRIVACY FIRST

Your information belongs to you. BlueShifts is designed to keep your data under your control and does not sell your personal information. We believe your schedule, earnings and work-related information should remain private.

Whether you're a patrol officer, deputy sheriff, state trooper, investigator, supervisor or other law enforcement professional, BlueShifts helps you stay organized, informed and prepared.
 
Built by a Police Officer. Designed for Police Life.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

BlueShifts Month is an auto-renewable subscription.

* Title: BlueShifts Month (Monthly)
* Length: 1 month, auto-renewing
* Price: $0.99 USD per month
* New users receive a 2-month free trial. After the trial ends, the subscription renews at $0.99 per month unless cancelled.

Payment is charged
